own_solution.law: A(t) = [ln(2)/T_half][m/(59.93 u)] 2^(-t/T_half), converting atomic mass to grams and half-life to seconds.
assumptions: The isotope follows exponential decay with the stated half-life.
Only radioactive cobalt inside the capsule contributes to the source's activity.
A year is converted using 365.25 days.
